newsitem.title: CHINA: China Strat may take control of Siu-Fung.
newsitem.headline: China Strat may take control of Siu-Fung.

text.p: China Strategic Holdings Ltd said on Monday it would underwrite a proposed rights issue of 1.44 billion new shares of Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd, which might result in its taking control of the firm.

The rights shares will be offered at HK$0.30 each to existing Siu-Fung shareholders in the proportion of one rights share for every existing share held, together with one free one-year warrant for every three rights shares.
Each warrant will give the holder the right to subscribe for one Siu-Fung share at HK$0.40 each, the companies said in a joint statement.

Siu-Fung's chairman Siegfried Lee had undertaken to transfer the full entitlement of his 778.91 million nil-paid rights shares, or 27.09 percent of the enlarged share capital, to China Strategic, the statement said.
Upon completion, Lee's stake in Siu-Fung will be reduced to 27.09 percent from a controlling 54.18 percent.
China Strategic, which does not hold any Siu-Fung shares now, after the deal will hold 57.14 percent of Siu-Fung assuming full subscription of the rights shares and exercise of the warrants, it said.
The net proceeds of HK$431.32 million before expenses will be used as working capital, it said.

The statement said the deal was to assist Siu-Fung to reach agreement with its banks and creditors to restructure its existing outstanding debts of Siu-Fung and to restore the company to profitability.

Siu-Fung had experienced serious cash flow difficulties during the second half of 1996, owing HK$2.42 billion to banks and other creditors in Hong Kong as at March 31, 1997. Its shares had been suspended from trade since October 28, 1996.
On completion, Lee will resign as chairman of Siu-Fung but will remain as a director.
China Strategic said it had "no present intention of changing the current business of the Siu-Fung Group, nor does it intend to inject material assets into the Siu-Fung Group".
Siu-Fung said it would make another statement on the finalisation of detailed terms of the rights issue and underwriting arrangement.
